description: This class defines a data model named ModuleConfig that holds configuration properties such as scheme, host, port, uri, environment, and additional configuration parameters.

classes.name: ModuleConfig
classes.description: A Java POJO (Plain Old Java Object) representing module configuration properties such as scheme, host, port, uri, environment, and other custom configurations.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Returns the scheme (e.g., http or https) for the module configuration.

methods.name: setScheme
methods.description: Sets the scheme (e.g., http or https) for the module configuration.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the host name or IP address for the module configuration.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets the host name or IP address for the module configuration.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number for the module configuration.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the port number for the module configuration.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI path for the module configuration.

methods.name: setUri
methods.description: Sets the URI path for the module configuration.

methods.name: getEnv
methods.description: Returns the environment setting for the module configuration.

methods.name: setEnv
methods.description: Sets the environment setting for the module configuration.
